note: known_failures must not grow; a row that starts passing must have its marker removed. Thresholds ratchet upward only -- for a given (corpus, embedder, gate model, judge). Change any of those and they are re-measured, never lowered to clear a red build. Datasets are stored per embedder for the same reason: which rows are known failures is a property of the retrieval config.

observed_when_set.why_answer_relevance_is_low: answer_relevance is the only threshold not at 0.90. The heuristic judge scores it as lexical overlap with the question and is documented as paraphrase-blind by design; statutory drafting does not repeat its own headings, so s.159 -- titled 'Commencement' -- says 'come into force', and the offline extractive stub quoting it scores 0.00 on a question about commencement while scoring groundedness 1.00 and citation coverage 1.00 on the same answer. The floor sits under the measured value for stub-local, which the gate pins for determinism. It is not a claim about the serving model: deepseek-v4-flash scores 0.82 mean answer relevance on these rows.
